name: AgentFirstStack
description: Web analytics, tag management with server-side conversion tracking, email inboxes and session replay for AI agents. Each skill runs AgentFirstStack tools: send a data part {"tool": "<name>", "arguments": {...}}; send plain text to get the tool list.

bearer.description: An afs_ API key from POST https://agentfirststack.com/v1/signup (one request, no email), or an OAuth access token.

skills.name: Web analytics
skills.description: Run analytics_* tools: create a site and get its snippet, verify the install, stats by country, page, source and device, goals, funnels, realtime, server events, AI crawler visits, history imported from GA4, Plausible or other tools, read-only SQL.

skills.name: Tags and conversion tracking
skills.description: Run tags_* tools: containers, site scan, GTM container import, conversion setup for GA4, Google Ads, Meta and TikTok, test events, publish, event log.

skills.name: Email inboxes
skills.description: Run mail_* tools: create an inbox, wait for a verification email with the code and link extracted, read, reply, send, forward to the project's people, custom domains, webhooks.

skills.name: Session replay
skills.description: Run replay_* tools: record sessions masked by default, search them, read a session as a transcript, find rage, dead and error clicks, heatmaps and JS errors, share a replay with a person.

skills.name: Account and handover
skills.description: Run afs_* tools: afs_check_setup says what the setup still lacks and how to fix it; afs_test_setup and afs_check_test_visit send test traffic through every service and check a browser test visit; afs_get_usage lists every fair-use limit with what the project has used and the ones it's close to; afs_update_project renames the project; afs_create_claim_link gives the owner a link to claim the project with Google sign-in; afs_delete_project deletes an unclaimed project (restorable for 7 days).

skills.name: List tools
skills.description: Send any plain-text message to get every tool available to your key and how to call it.
